name: Ore-Ida Golden Crinkle Cut French Fries
whyItWorks: Peeled russet potatoes cut into crinkles. Thick crinkle cuts retain a high proportion of soft, fluffy potato flesh relative to surface oil, providing gentle potassium and comforting carbs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake on a parchment-lined baking sheet until crisp on tips. Dip in low-FODMAP ketchup.
watchOuts: Bake or air-fry; do not submerge in deep fryer oil.
